statement: For every odd prime l, every nontrivial closed procyclic subgroup of the stable genus-two S3 quotient's geometric pro-l group with open arithmetic normalizer is cuspidal. Together with A.14 at l=2, this completes the normalizer classification for all first covers and displayed genus-two quotients.
depends_on: A.4; A.11; A.12; Betts-Dogra Definition 3.1.5 and Theorem 3.1.6; Silverman VII.5.5
notes: After potential good reduction of E above2, the stable genus-two fibre has two elliptic components, and the degree3 map to E has component degrees1 and2. A proper homology vector in ker f_* therefore has nonzero projections to both components. The actual tame separating monodromy T(v) is not in [v,L2], witnessed by a->x,c->-x,b->y,d->y. The proof uses the proper curve after homology detection, so it makes no invalid lifting through the odd-prime C3-to-D3 quotient. The stable model is proved geometrically, not claimed as a machine computation.
